title: signrules: sign completion on the ecological Grassmannian
description:
A Python package that proves Lotka–Volterra sign patterns impossible: no magnitudes with the given signs of the growth rates and of the interaction matrix have a positive, locally asymptotically stable equilibrium. It runs Grassmann–Plücker propagation and the sign rules R1–R8 on the Plücker coordinates of [diag(a) | B] in Gr(n, 2n), writes a machine certificate for every proof, and replays each certificate with an independent checker.

The record contains the classification of sign patterns on four, five and six species: every four-species pattern and every five- and six-species candidate of the extension screens is either killed at the root (its certificate is regenerated and replayed) or has a certificate of possibility, a rational matrix checked stable in exact arithmetic. Exactly 11, 24 and 41 non-trivial patterns are impossible. The command signrules verify checks it all. The record also holds the scripts that reproduce the numbers of the papers and their records.
